resolved_facts.claim: Simplex Financial Holdings remains outside the classic Buffett/Weschler power zone: croupier archetype, partial moat, partial dhando, and cyclical success-fee earnings — seated for quality_reinvestment cross-check but not a durable compounder with proven reinvestable owner earnings.

The 2026-07-24 contract backfill met the economic ownership map and overlap controls (four valid proofs, additive base ¥2,264/sh), but etf_product_pipeline still lacks incremental ROIC or reinvestment-rate traces required by the quality_reinvestment route, and no targeted research loop answered that gap.

At unconfirmed ¥757 (likely BVPS, not last trade), contract base return 16.94% per year may clear the 12% hurdle on paper, but illiquid TSE execution and peak success-fee cyclicality block approve; watch pending live quote, liquidity, and filing-verified reinvestment economics.

Universal contract sums four additive components to ¥2,264.38/sh base (core_fee_engine ¥2,239, etf_product_pipeline ¥100, net_financial_claims ¥65, performance_fee_cycle_reserve −¥140) with valid calculation proofs, decision_grade status, and no overlap double-count.

FY2026 success fees were ¥14.316B (+53.6% YoY) versus base fees ¥7.869B (+17.1%) on AUM ¥1.3357tn (+2.9%), so performance fees were ~65% of combined fees while the Lawrence and contract anchors use FY2025 mid-cycle owner cash ¥137.14/sh, not peak FY2026 ¥317.33/sh.

Entry price remains unresolved: valuation.json and contract math use Yahoo ¥757 (matching BVPS ¥757.01), while the last documented TSE print is ¥464 for 100 shares with only two volume days in twelve months, so modeled returns are not an investable entry without broker confirmation.

Contract backfill attached valid calculation_proof graphs for all four additive components; base sum ¥2,264.38/sh annualizes to 16.94% over 7 years at ¥757, while Lawrence synthesis remains 38.04%—a wide gap driven by terminal-multiple and growth judgments in core_fee_engine.

FY2026 success fees were ¥14.316B (+53.6% YoY), roughly 65% of combined base plus success fees; performance_fee_cycle_reserve applies a filing-grounded −¥140/sh base adjustment against peak-cycle earnings.

etf_product_pipeline base ¥100/sh and net_financial_claims 8.59% book claim_share remain judgment plugs without standalone filing bridges despite valid proof status; deep-dive executive summary still cites 53.33% at ¥464 while the valuation ledger uses ¥757 and 38.04%.
